name: Grounded 3D-LLM
description: A unified generative framework for 3D large multi-modal models that consolidates various 3D vision tasks using scene referent tokens and per-task instruction-following templates. It includes a large-scale grounded scene-text dataset with over 1 million phrase-to-region correspondences and introduces Contrastive Language-Scene Pre-training (CLASP) for phrase-level scene-text alignment.
reputation: A recent research benchmark for grounded 3D multimodal understanding that is gaining attention in 3D vision and embodied AI communities, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes a large-scale dataset and novel pre-training method; evaluated on multiple 3D vision tasks.
